title: Industrial Chemicals Act 2019
notes: Includes amendments up to Act No. 39, 2024. Governs AICIS registration, categorisation and annual declarations.

title: Model Work Health and Safety Regulations
notes: Model law with no legal effect of its own; each state and territory enacts its own version. Chapter 7 covers hazardous chemicals, registers, SDS and manifests.

title: Model Work Health and Safety Bill
notes: Model law with no legal effect of its own. Parent Act for the Regulations above.

title: Hazardous Substances and New Organisms Act 1996
notes: Administered by the EPA. Substance approvals and group standards.

title: Health and Safety at Work (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2017
notes: LI 2017/131, administered by MBIE, enforced by WorkSafe. Workplace inventory, SDS, certificates.
